Which way does my house face?

A house faces the way you look when you stand in the front door and look out to the street.

Set the direction

Drag the dial, or focus it and use the arrow keys. The yellow arrow is the front door.

0 is north, 90 east, 180 south, 270 west.
Phone compass Stand in the doorway, hold the phone flat and point the top of it at the street.

Result

House faces 
Backyard faces 

Sun in Texas

Texas lies between about 26 and 36 degrees north, so the midday sun is in the southern sky all year. Phone compasses read magnetic north, which is a few degrees off true north in Texas, and can be thrown off by nearby steel or a phone case with magnets.
